title: EU leaders end summit without budget deal, Ukraine loan delayed to December
caption:
EU leaders ended a summit in Brussels without agreeing on the bloc's 2028–2034 budget. A proposed €45bn loan for Ukraine in 2027 is backed by 24 of 27 member states, European Council President António Costa says, but Slovakia, Hungary and Czechia are holding out. Leaders will return to both issues at their summit in mid-December.
